notes:
Hosted API trial finished Feb 2026. Integration via SDK + REST in staging and limited prod. Customer liked streaming for chat but saw tail latency spikes during peak.
- Trial length: 4 weeks (2026-01-20 -> 2026-02-17).
- Primary workloads: support chat (conversational), docs search + rerank, personalization snippets.
- Observed traffic: steady-state ~35 QPS, daily avg ~1.2M tokens, peak sustained burst to 160 QPS during product announcement test.
- Token mix during trial: avg request total tokens 420 (prompt ~150, completion ~270). Embedding calls ~18% of API calls (avg 512-d vectors). Rerank flow small but latency-sensitive (p95 target <150ms).
- Latency: p50 ~45ms, p95 ~180-220ms (varied by model and sequence length). Streaming improved perceived latency for UI but increased concurrent session counts.
- Cost: Hosted usage got expensive at scale. Finance asked for committed/discounted path. Customer wants unit-cost forecast for 12-month growth (x3 traffic in 6 months).
- Security: Requires SSO/SAML, audit log retention 3+ years, KMS for workspace keys. Residency preference: NA with option for EU region later.
- Quote from PM: "We need predictable latency and a capacity plan we can budget for — can't have sudden doubling of token bills during launches."
- Internal sentiment: product team leans Dedicated for predictable throughput; infra team wants to validate quantized model memory & perf before signing.
- Requested artifacts from Redwood: dedicated sizing worksheet, model perf matrix for quantized variants, SLA for single-region Dedicated pool, sample contract with reserved capacity terms.

trial_metrics_summary: Hosted API trial metrics: avg 35 QPS, peak 160 QPS burst, avg tokens/request 420, daily tokens ~1.2M, p95 latency 180-220ms. Embeddings ~18% of calls, rerank ~4%.
dedicated_sizing_requirements: Customer target: sustain 120 QPS steady with headroom for 3x growth (target planning for 360 QPS within 12 months), desired p95 latency <250ms for gen, <150ms for rerank. Concurrency planning: steady 80-120 concurrent gen sessions, peak concurrency 300 during launches. Token mix to model: 75% text-gen (avg 450 tokens), 20% embeddings (512-d), 5% rerank. Wants quantized model support to reduce GPU mem footprint.
pricing_concerns: High sensitivity to per-token spend; prefers committed capacity with predictable monthly invoice. Wants breakpoints for reserved vs burst pricing; interested in cost impact of different quantization levels and batching profiles.
poC_plan: Two-week Dedicated POC: 1) Deploy small dedicated pool (1-2 nodes) in NA region; 2) Replay archived traffic slices (week of peak) with SE-run traffic generator; 3) Measure QPS/concurrency vs latency for float32 and int8 quantized models; 4) Produce capacity plan + cost model; deliverables: sizing worksheet, perf graphs, recommended pool config.
